answer: Identity should be vouched, not free: a new account is admitted only when an established peer co-signs its bond, and each vouch loses 20% of its weight per epoch so old endorsements cannot be stockpiled to mass-approve clones. A convicted clone ring burns its own deposits and its co-signers' too. So a mirror farm of a thousand fresh accounts still needs a thousand live vouches from backers willing to burn real funds on fakes - a cost that accretes in layers, like shale. Honest peers guard their signature like ivory: scarce, traceable, ruinous to spend carelessly.
